name: Nori Egg Wraps with Miso-Peanut Butter Slaw
steps: Finely zest the lime then squeeze the juice into a bowl. Whisk in the peanut butter, miso, ⅔ of the soy sauce and honey.
Finely slice the spring onions. Toss the rainbow slaw mix into the dressing. Fold through the coriander leaves and half of the spring onions..
Whisk together the eggs with the remaining ⅓ soy sauce.

Put a nori wrap in a 26cm nonstick frying pan so that the wrap fits neatly into the base. Pour over half of the eggs, using the curved side of a spoon to evenly distribute the egg over the wrap, pushing up into the corners as far as you can go.

Sprinkle over the remaining spring onions then cover with a tight fitting lid and cook for 2-3 mins, until the eggs are set and puffy. Slide onto a plate an repeat with the remaining nori wrap and egg mixture.

Once you've gone through all the egg mix. Take each nori omelette and layer another sheet of nori on top, sandwiching the egg in the middle, then dollop the slaw in the middle and roll up. Serve with sriracha, if you fancy.
